taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts A. speciosa and includes Texas in the native range.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: TPWD places Texas populations in seeps and mucky river bottoms along the Red and Canadian rivers in the Rolling Plains, outside the project's target-zone counties.
target_zone_range.guardrail: State-level Texas nativity does not satisfy the project county rule.

morphology.look_here_first: Showy milkweed is a tall stout, densely white-tomentose perennial with broad opposite leaves and large purplish-rose umbels; it is a northern/western Texas comparison rather than a Central Texas target-zone native.
